AgentWiring.description: Agent-side wiring of the vendor CLI.

wrapper.description: `jentic <cli>` on the agent's machine; unset: not wrapped.

AgentWiring.title: AgentWiring

ApiIdentity.description: The registry identity an API resolves to (slug form, as the registry stores it).

version.description: API version. Required for `shipped` and `builtin` sources; unset for a `catalog` source, whose version is the imported spec's.
version.title: Version

ApiIdentity.title: ApiIdentity

ApiRole.description:
What one of a profile's APIs is to the vendor's CLI.

The role decides which rule kind applies to the API's binding: ``rest``
and ``uploads`` take path rules (``regex``, ``prefix``, ``exact``),
``graphql`` takes GraphQL top-level-field rules and ``git`` takes git
repository/ref rules.
ApiRole.title: ApiRole

CliBinary.description: The vendor CLI the profile governs.

binary.description: Executable name looked up on PATH, e.g. `gh`.
binary.title: Binary

supported_range.description: CLI versions the profile is written for, e.g. `>=2.40.0,<3`.
supported_range.title: Supported Range

CliBinary.title: CliBinary

ContainerWiring.description: The environment ``jentic run --container`` gives the agent for this vendor.

env_set.description: Variables to set; a value is a literal or `{placeholder}`.
env_set.title: Env Set

env_strip.description: Variables removed from the agent's environment.
env_strip.title: Env Strip

tunnel_hosts.description: Hosts the vendor's tools need reached directly (tunnelled, never decrypted); an exact host or one with `*` for one whole label.
tunnel_hosts.title: Tunnel Hosts

ContainerWiring.title: ContainerWiring

CredentialPolicy.description: How credentials for the profile's APIs are held.

mode.description: `per_api`: each API has its own credential, created by its own `connect` entry. `profile_scoped` (reserved, not accepted yet): one credential covering exactly the profile's APIs, created by the profile's `connect`.
mode.title: Mode

CredentialPolicy.title: CredentialPolicy

EgressRouting.description: How the egress proxy of ``jentic run --container`` treats the vendor.

governed_domains.description: Domains whose hosts the proxy TLS-terminates and relays to the broker with the vendor's invocation token.
governed_domains.title: Governed Domains

EgressRouting.title: EgressRouting

FacadeRoute.description: One request layout the vendor facade maps to an upstream.

api.description: The role of the API the route's calls resolve to.

path.description: An exact path that maps to `upstream` itself.
path.title: Path

prefix.description: A path prefix: `<prefix>/<rest>` maps to `<upstream>/<rest>`. In `path` mode it is below the facade's own `/_facade/<vendor>`; `/` is that root.
prefix.title: Prefix

upstream.description: The `https://` upstream the route forwards to.
upstream.title: Upstream

FacadeRoute.title: FacadeRoute

FacadeRouting.description: How the broker's facade for the vendor is laid out.

mode.description: `host`: on a hostname of its own; `path`: under `/_facade/<vendor>`.
mode.title: Mode

FacadeRouting.title: FacadeRouting

HardDenySource.description:
A hard-deny list that applies to one of the profile's APIs.

The list itself lives in code (``source`` names it); the manifest only
references it, so there is one source of truth for what no rule can allow.

api.description: The role of the API the list applies to.

description.description: What the list guards, for operators.
description.title: Description

kind.description: `graphql_mutation`: top-level mutations always denied; `graphql_held_mutation`: mutations always held for approval; `git_ref`: refs no push may touch.
kind.title: Kind

source.description: The code that holds the list, as `<module>:<attribute>`.
source.title: Source

HardDenySource.title: HardDenySource

Preset.description: A named set of rules across the profile's APIs.

description.description: What the preset grants, shown to agent and approver.
description.title: Description

Preset.title: Preset

PresetParam.description: A parameter a preset's rules are filled in with.

default.description: Value used when the parameter is not given.
default.title: Default

description.description: What the parameter means, shown to the agent.
description.title: Description

kind.description: `repo_list`: comma-separated `<owner>/<repo>` globs; `ref_glob`: a branch glob below `refs/heads/` (e.g. `agent/*`); `flag`: `true` or `false`.
kind.title: Kind

PresetParam.title: PresetParam

PresetRule.description:
One rule (or rule set) a preset expands into, for one of the profile's APIs.

Either a rule of its own (``effect`` plus ``methods``/``path``/
``match_mode``/``operations``, with ``${param}`` references) or an
``include`` of a named rule set kept in code.

api.description: The role of the API whose binding gets the rule.

for_each.description: A `repo_list` parameter: the rule is repeated once per listed repository, with `${<param>}` standing for one repository.
for_each.title: For Each

include.description: A named rule set kept in code, e.g. `github_graphql:pr_write`.
include.title: Include

when.description: A `flag` parameter: the rule applies only when it is true.
when.title: When

PresetRule.title: PresetRule

ProfileApi.description: One API of the vendor that the CLI reaches through Jentic.

api_id.description: The catalog-style api_id (`<domain>/<name>`) a vendor entry names the API by. Required for a `shipped` source; for `catalog` and `builtin` it is the source's own id and may be omitted.
api_id.title: Api Id

connect.description: The `vendors.entries` key whose connect flow creates this API's credential (per-API credential mode). Unset when the API is connected another way (an API-target connect or a hand-entered credential).
connect.title: Connect

description.description: What the API covers, for operators.
description.title: Description

identity.description: The registry identity the API resolves to.

role.description: What the API is to the CLI; stable across releases.

source.description: Where the API comes from: `catalog:<catalog api_id>`, `shipped:specs/<file>` (a spec in this package) or `builtin:<catalog api_id>`.
source.title: Source

ProfileApi.title: ProfileApi

ProfileConnect.description: The single connect that covers the whole profile (``profile_scoped`` credentials).

flow.description: The flow to use; unset takes the entry's first flow.
flow.title: Flow

vendor_entry.description: The `vendors.entries` key the profile connects with.
vendor_entry.title: Vendor Entry

ProfileConnect.title: ProfileConnect

Routing.description: Facade and proxy routing for the vendor.
Routing.title: Routing

VendorSpec.description: The vendor whose CLI the profile governs.

display_name.description: How the vendor is named to people.
display_name.title: Display Name

error_shape.description: The error body shape the vendor's CLI understands; unset keeps RFC 9457.
error_shape.title: Error Shape

id.description: The vendor's `cli_facades.vendors` key and invocation-token vendor, e.g. `github`.
id.title: Id

registry_domains.description: Registry vendor domains whose APIs this vendor's invocation tokens reach at the proxy route; errors on a host at or below one take the vendor's error shape.
registry_domains.title: Registry Domains

VendorSpec.title: VendorSpec

WrapperWiring.description: The environment the CLI wrapper (``jentic <cli>``) gives the vendor CLI.

env_set.description: Variables to set; a value is a literal or one of `{address}`, `{address_host}`, `{token}`.
env_set.title: Env Set

env_strip.description: Credential variables the CLI could authenticate with instead; removed so only the invocation token is presented.
env_strip.title: Env Strip

WrapperWiring.title: WrapperWiring

connect.description: The single connect for the whole profile. Used by `profile_scoped` credentials; with `per_api`, each API's own `connect` is used.

display_name.description: How the profile is named to people.
display_name.title: Display Name
